source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of acceptance testing (PDF 27-28).

blocks.text: Acceptance Testing testing ka aakhri level hai jo yeh tay karne ke liye kiya jata hai ke software release ke liye tayyar hai ya nahi. Yeh aksar end-users (aakhri istemal karne wale) ya clients karte hain ta ke yaqeen ho ke software un ki expectations (umeedein) aur requirements poori karta hai. Acceptance testing formal (official, likhe hue tareeqe se) ya informal (bina khaas tareeqe ke) ho sakti hai, aur is mein aam taur par asal istemal jaise scenarios (halaat) hote hain jin se software ki usability (istemal mein aasani), reliability aur performance jaanchi jati hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Acceptance testing ko kabhi User Acceptance Testing (UAT) bhi kaha jata hai, kyun ke yeh aksar software ke end-users karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Acceptance testing aam taur par kaun karta hai, aur yeh kya tay karti hai?
blocks.explanation: End-users ya clients; yeh tay karti hai ke software un ki zarooratein poori karta hai aur release ke liye tayyar hai ya nahi.

items: Acceptance testing: aakhri level; users ya clients asal jaise scenarios mein jaanch kar tay karte hain ke software tayyar hai (UAT).
